stop.limitation: A stop needs at least medium confidence. Killing a channel on no data is how a working channel gets killed.

recommendations.rationale: No platform data and no lead data are available for this window. The correct action is to close the measurement gap, not to make a channel decision on nothing.

recommendations.subject: measurement
recommendations.rationale: Every question in this report is unanswerable for the same reason: no input is connected. One connected input — the lead sheet, once capture is live — would make four of the seven answerable. That is the highest-leverage change available and it needs no new tooling.

hypothesis.statement: If the Scorecard capture is switched on, then within two weeks the lead sheet will attribute at least one lead to a specific utm_content value, making per-post attribution real rather than theoretical.
hypothesis.measured_by: count of lead rows with a non-empty utm_content in the lead sheet
